hooks.command: f=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); f="${f//\\//}"; case "$f" in *lists/sources/*|*lists/releases/*|*/Filters/*|*userscripts/dist/*) echo "Blocked: $f is CI-generated (see AGENTS.md). Edit the source file instead." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
f=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); f="${f//\\//}"; case "$f" in *lists/adblock/*.txt) bun x @adguard/aglint --fix "$f" >&2 ;; esac
f=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); f="${f//\\//}"; case "$f" in *.py) uv run ruff check --fix "$f" >&2; uv run ruff format "$f" >&2 ;; esac
f=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); f="${f//\\//}"; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.json) bun x oxlint --fix --quiet "$f" >&2 || true; bun x biome format --write "$f" >&2 ;; esac
